title: atomic_dec_if_positive prevents FIPS enforcement silent-disable on double-unregister
description: crypto2dev_unregister_provider() uses atomic_dec_if_positive() with WARN on underflow, not atomic_dec(). If two FIPS providers are loaded and one double-unregisters, atomic_dec() would take count from 2 to 1 to 0, silently disabling FIPS enforcement while the second FIPS provider is still loaded. atomic_dec_if_positive() stops at 0 and fires WARN, making the bug visible without silently clearing FIPS mode. A reviewer might suggest 'use atomic_dec, it is simpler' — that change would allow a double-unregister bug to silently disable the FIPS-only dispatch path, which is a CMVP certification failure. The inline comment explains this; do not simplify it away.
